summary: PLDT Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting its submission of a registration statement for the proposed initial public offering (IPO) of its subsidiary, VITRO REIT. The filing is a press release noting compliance with Philippine disclosure rules and Section 17.1 of the Securities Regulation Code. No specific terms such as price per share, stake percentage, or expected closing date were provided. PLDT is the issuer of the filing but may be the selling shareholder in the IPO. The transaction is at an early pre-IPO stage. Investors should watch for the registration statement's effectiveness, IPO pricing details, and any regulatory approvals from Philippine authorities.
